name: Micronaut Core 5.2.22
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Cache exception handler lookups instead of re-resolving and contending on every error by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14212
* Preserve Python exceptions across synchronous AOP calls by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14224
* Parse X-Forwarded-Host like the Forwarded host by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14243
### Dependency updates 🚀
* Update Netty to 4.2.20.Final by @sdelamo in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14253
### Other Changes 💡
* Bind the default locale to Locale arguments when the request has none by @sharanggupta in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14102
* Give inject-java's Groovy test compilation a 3 GB compiler daemon of its own by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14187
* Retry failing repository requests longer before Gradle gives up on the repository by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14188
* Expand Iterable and array values passed to UriBuilder.queryParam into… by @sdelamo in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14197


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.21...v5.2.22
